spans.text: A week later, in a temporary Vory hideout.
Gleb checks his guns and ammo, then stands up and stares intently at the model of the bar in front of him.
Has the message been relayed? Do they know their respective tasks?
Yes, I've checked and double-checked.
Valeriya slowly steps out of the shadowed doorway and adjusts her husband's tie with her cold hands.
Per your instructions, their submachine guns have been fitted with suppressors and they're all wearing soft-soled shoes, so they won't make noise while walking on wooden floorboards.
What about the axe I asked for?
Valeriya points to the sofa beside the door—an arc of gleaming white light lies on the tattered black leather, radiating cold menace.
Gleb smiles and hefts the axe. He strokes its blade carefully before swiftly fastening it behind him.
There's nothing better than this for chopping off fingers.
The "Chief Financier" will surely be happy with our gift... Don't you think, my dear Valyusha?
Gleb laughs as he pushes the door open. Four henchmen are outside, waiting for orders.
Tonight, we drink our enemies' blood!
MOVE OUT!
It is in the dead of winter, and the city is shrouded in darkness—naturally, this also includes a little bar called the "Lubyanka".
However, very few people know that this unassuming bar often receives guests from the Neo-Soviet government—they come here to relax and wash away the fatigue of daily life with alcohol.
This is their heaven of intoxication, and also Gleb's current hunting ground.
Early in the morning, two men in black walk up to the door of the "Lubyanka" bar, and then they suddenly stop.
Please show—
Bang!
Bang!
Before the two guards can finish, they are shot dead by the men in black.
The men in black kick open the "Lubyanka" bar's main door—
Bangbangbang—
They sweep the counter with withering firepower, like they've rehearsed this before...
A moment later, six people emerge from the three doors of the bar and meet again in the center of the first floor.
We've executed all the guards outside. The interior of the first floor has been cleared. No sign of the target.
Very good. Stay here and fortify a position. I'll handle the second floor.

Gleb smiles savagely as he pats Valeriya's shoulder, then pivots on his heel before stepping over the remains of the ruined crystal chandeliers and treading on a bloodstained icon. He raises his gun and head upstairs...
Inside a certain room on the second floor of the "Lubyanka" bar.
An important government official lies on a sofa under the flickering candlelight in the darkness. It's clear from the smile on his face that he is still lost in his warm, inebriated dreams.
With a "thud", a mighty force flings him to the ground and the back of his half-bald head smashes into the ground.
(Winces) ...Who the f*ck hit me...?!
The dignitary rubs his head and sits up groggily, half-awake and half asleep as he belches several times, releasing the stench of alcohol into the air.
Gleb smiles and takes a handgun out of its holster.
The combination of the sensation of cool metal on his forehead, the heavy smell of gun oil and the sound of a round chambering are what bring the official to his senses.
You... What the hell are you doing?! Do you know who I am?!
Gleb laughs, and there is an added layer of nuance to his mirth—how could a mover and shaker like him possibly remember a petty little KGB agent like himself?
And he's not the only one; why would any of these so-called "cake-eaters", who never wanted for anything, even bother worrying about maggots like him?
I-I'll pay you anything, just name your price! I stake my life on it...
No need for that, sir. I'm simply here on behalf of the "Chief Financier" to give you his regards.
Sweet dreams.
Bang!
After a gunshot, the political dignitary collapses into a pool of blood.
Gleb smiles in satisfaction and lifts the man's right hand—just as he remembered, he has a ruby ring on his right ring finger that proves his identity.
Gleb grins as he takes out the axe at his back...
An arc of silver flashes through the darkness and the ring falls easily from the severed finger. After spinning twice on the ground, it finally comes to a halt by Gleb's foot.
By the time Gleb returns to the first floor, Valeriya and the other four have doused every inch of the bar with gasoline.
Valeriya casts a questioning glance at Gleb, and Gleb smiles triumphantly.
The sounds of police sirens can be heard far off in the streets.
The group walks onto the street and start up a black van that's been prepared ahead of time.
Before leaving, Gleb bends down to light a cigarette.
As he exhales a cloud of smoke, he gives the "Lubyanka" bar one last look and then flicks his cigarette through the broken glass like he was tossing a piece of rubbish away.
Foom—
As the intense flames blaze up, the black van drives away, never to return...
